benchmarkProxy.name: Bench Press
benchmarkProxy.note: CMU machine calibration: 115 lb × 10 matches a 175 lb × 1 bench press using estimated 1RM. Bench Press standards are scaled to 87.62%. This is a bench-equivalent estimate from one comparison, not measured machine-specific population percentiles. Log the displayed machine weight; compare on the same machine and settings.

benchmarkEvidence.note: Community reference, not a controlled research norm. Machine leverage, pulley ratio, setup and range of motion affect the load; compare progress on the same machine with consistent technique. Do not treat the percentile as an exact rank across machines. Use the seated two-leg variation; lying and single-leg curls are different exercises.
